region_mappings.provenance: computed: lesion mask intersect DK+aseg labelmap in MNI152 1mm space. CT-ICH native scanner space (CT) -> MNI152 dipy affine registration (mutual information), mask warped nearest-neighbour. Labelmap voxelized from the atlas meshes (nearest-region assignment within the MNI152 brain mask), so labels are the regions.json ids. role=primary when overlap_fraction_of_region >= 0.10. Registration and voxel parcellation are approximate; pending expert review. hemorrhage = CT-ICH manual hemorrhage segmentation (patient 073), native CT space. CT-ICH is not MNI-normalized, so the bleed reaches atlas space via its own CT; CT->T1-template registration is cross-modality and approximate (see NOTE(neuro-review) in build code).
